In the room

Services

Book straight on WhatsApp. We reply with prices and times.

Studio session

Book a session with an experienced TAB engineer in a professionally treated studio, from Cheltenham to South London. We set up and soundcheck before you arrive, so the session is spent creating. You leave with clean, well-recorded files that are ready to mix. Prices depend on the day, time, studio and engineer: fill this in and we'll send a quote.

Monthly retainer

Artist development

£250/month

For artists ready to put in consistent work. Every month you get real studio time, finished music and the content to show it off, with the TAB team behind you.

  • 2 × 4-hour studio blocks
  • 1 mix & master
  • 1 behind-the-scenes reel
  • 5 edited press photos
Book now

Mixing

£100/track

Your song mixed so every part sits where it should, from the vocal on top to the low end. We work to your references and your vision, and one round of changes is included to get it feeling right. You get a full-quality mix you can play anywhere.

1 round of changes included · extra rounds £25

Book now

Mix & master

£125/track

Our full finishing service, taking your stems to a release-ready track. We mix it to sound balanced and powerful, then master it to sit loud and clear next to the music you love on every streaming platform.

1 round of changes included · extra rounds £25

Book now

Mastering

£50/track

The final polish before release. We bring your finished mix to the right volume, tighten the tone and make sure it translates on phones, car speakers, club systems and headphones. You get a master that's ready to upload.

1 round of changes included · extra rounds £25

Book now

Production

Beats and full productions built around your sound, not a template. Bring an idea, a voice note or a reference and we'll build it with you in the room or remotely. You keep the creative control, and we'll agree clear terms before we start.

Get a quote

Photo & video

Shoots, visuals and behind-the-scenes content from photographers and videographers in the TAB network. Whether it's cover art, press shots or a music video, we match you with the right creative and help plan the shoot so it fits your music.

About us

The Audio Box

The Audio Box is a music network of engineers, producers, photographers, videographers and creatives across London and Gloucestershire. We run studio sessions, mix and master records, spotlight artists we rate and share what we're learning every Friday.

Privacy

How we handle the details you give us.

What The Audio Box does

The Audio Box is a music network across London and Gloucestershire. We publish a weekly blog, spotlight artists and share what's moving in music.

What we collect

  • Mailing list: your email address, so we can send you the weekly blog. Our mailing list is run by beehiiv.
  • Enquiries: whatever you choose to send us on WhatsApp, by email or on Instagram.

Our promise

  • We only use your details to send you the newsletter and reply to you.
  • We never sell or share your details.
  • You can unsubscribe from any email with one click, and ask us to delete your details at any time.

Where it is kept

  • Mailing list emails are stored by beehiiv under their privacy policy.
  • Messages you send on WhatsApp or Instagram are kept by those apps under their own privacy rules.

Questions or deleting your details

Email us at theaudiobox.pr@gmail.com or message us on Instagram @theaudiobox_. If you are unhappy with how your details have been handled, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.
